lcc_original: 惟獨園子當中那棵樹的果子，上帝卻眞地說過：「不可以喫，也不可摸，免得死亡。」』
notes: UNV 神 → LCC 上帝: systematic lexical difference; H430 assigned to 上帝 as the semantic equivalent
UNV 曾說 → LCC 卻眞地說過: SNs (H559+WTH8804) attached to 說過 (the main verb); 卻眞地 left unannotated as a LCC-specific rhetorical elaboration
UNV 死 → LCC 死亡: LCC nominalizes the verb; H4191+WTH8799 attached to 死亡 as the semantic unit
{<WAH0834>} remains implicit — no explicit relative pronoun in LCC, mirroring UNV usage
